issues: Wrong option 2 (Outposts at players' homes) is somewhat absurd but its why is accurate.
Route 53 latency routing is documented. Global Accelerator would also work but is not offered.

Correct option 1 ('Use the Direct Connect Resiliency Toolkit connection wizard') is a tooling/workflow action, not an architecture decision: the wizard only orders connections that option 2 already describes (connections at multiple locations). The two keys overlap, and the wizard is not required to meet the requirement, so the pair does not cleanly test a resilient design; the documented fact ('best practice is to use the Connection wizard') is a recommendation, not a requirement. A candidate who skips the wizard and orders connections at two locations meets the stem, so option 1 is arguably not necessary.

The stem says 'HIGHEST resiliency' (the documented Maximum resiliency model is connections at two or more locations, each with redundant connections/devices), but neither key states redundant connections per location or separate customer routers.
Also overlaps customs-house-012 (citadel), which already tests maximum resiliency (separate connections on separate devices in more than one location) without the toolkit wizard.
suggestedFix: Make the two keys design actions: (a) order dedicated connections at more than one Direct Connect location, and (b) terminate redundant connections on separate customer routers (or two connections per location, the Maximum resiliency model). Keep the toolkit only as a quote in the explanation, not as an option. If kept, make it distinct from customs-house-012 or drop it.
